status: Preliminary effective-material sizing study; user authorizes estimated properties
wall_requirement: User requires wall strictly greater than 2 mm. 2.01 mm is an explicit numerical margin, not a manufacturing tolerance.
bounds_status: Wall > 2 mm is user specified. OD bounds and upper wall bound are editable study bounds, not confirmed mount/manufacturing limits.
reference_status: Analyst-selected starting geometry; it must be screened against the active frequency target. Original 1.5 mm stock candidates violate the wall requirement.
frequency_requirement_basis: Preserves the supplied optimize_arm.py rotor_margin constraint f1 >= rpm/60. Derived from inputs.json RPM for each run. This is a sizing criterion, not a complete rotor-arm resonance or flutter assessment. Set the rotor multiple to null to recover the prior strength-only study; fixed Hz and rotor multiple are mutually exclusive.

material.name: Estimated effective roll-wrapped CFRP profile for preliminary optimization

property_basis.E_Pa: Easy Composites typical lengthwise tensile modulus used as effective bending modulus
property_basis.tensile_strength_Pa: Easy Composites typical lengthwise tensile strength; not a guaranteed design allowable
property_basis.density_kg_m3: Graphtek GR-CFRWT 1.52 g/cm3; estimate for the proposed tube
property_basis.compressive_strength_Pa: Graphtek GR-CFRWT comparison laminate; estimate for the proposed tube
property_basis.shear_strength_Pa: Graphtek GR-CFRWT torsional strength used as a nominal longitudinal shear proxy. Transfer to this laminate/transverse beam shear is unverified. Not an interlaminar allowable.

material.interpolation_policy: Optional thickness_samples rows require wall_mm and all five numerical properties. Piecewise-linear interpolation is allowed only inside the sampled thickness interval. No invented endpoints or extrapolation. Empty table uses the stated constant estimates.
material.limitations: Properties are held constant as dimensions vary. Laminate ply schedule and minimum allowables are not established. No shell buckling, ovalization, fatigue, joints, impact or dynamic follower-force stability prediction.
